**Note: False Positive Reports**
Please use this template ONLY for reporting legitimate apps or files that were flagged, blocked, or quarantined by HydraDragonAV Mobile.

**⚠️ IMPORTANT: Check Logs First ⚠️**
Before reporting a false positive, **please verify if the file was actually flagged** by HydraDragonAV Mobile. Check the in-app scan results and scan history to confirm.

**File / App Information**
- App Name / Filename:
- Package Name (if Android app):
- SHA256 Hash:
- Download Link (if applicable):
- Software Name / Publisher / Developer:

**Which component flagged it?**
- [ ] YARA-X Signature Scan
- [ ] ClamAV Signature Scan
- [ ] TLSH Fuzzy Hash Matching
- [ ] ML Anomaly Detection
- [ ] AIEngine (DEX-level behavioral scoring)
- [ ] Network Security Scanner
- [ ] Web Shield / DNS Filtering
- [ ] On-Screen Text Scanner
- [ ] Native-Code Emulation (Unicorn Engine)
- [ ] Malicious/Phishing URL String Scanner
- [ ] Behavioral Detection Suite
- [ ] Unknown / General Detection

**Describe the False Positive**
A clear description of what the app/file does and why it is legitimate/benign. If it is your own app, providing the source code or a link to the app store listing is helpful.

**VirusTotal Link**
Provide a link to the VirusTotal analysis for this file (if uploaded):

**Additional context**
Add any other context about the file or detection here.
